environment.description: Container deployed via internal platform team's hardened base image (gcr.io/infra-secured/distroless-go:nonroot). Pod spec includes securityContext with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. No emptyDir, tmpfs, or PVC volumes are mounted. The container's ephemeral storage is entirely immutable. The PostgreSQL connection uses a connection pooler (PgBouncer) configured in transaction mode with a prepared statement cache that rejects queries containing single-quote characters outside of dollar-quoted strings (custom pgbouncer patch from internal fork at commit 3a8f1e2, applied via the pool_mode=transaction and custom_sanitize_mode=strict settings). The database user granted to the application has SECURITY LABEL 'restricted_interpolation' which triggers a custom PostgreSQL event trigger that aborts any query where the planner detects a constant string comparison that wasn't present in the original prepared statement template.

config.volumes: none (no emptyDir, no tmpfs, no PVC)

pgbouncer.behavior: rejects queries containing unescaped single-quote literals outside dollar-quoting

postgresql_event_trigger.behavior: aborts execution when query planner detects injected constant comparisons not matching prepared statement template

config.filesystem_note: readOnlyRootFilesystem prevents cache writes but application handles this gracefully via non-fatal error logging
